result.summary: The page is generally visually polished, but a few horizontally clipped elements and bottom-overlay behavior make the layout look slightly broken.

issues.description: The category carousel shows a partially clipped pill at the far right, making the next category appear cut off at the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Keep the peek behavior if horizontal scrolling is intentional, but add clearer scroll affordance or adjust spacing so the clipped item looks deliberate.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is cut off on the right, including its restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel has a clear horizontal-scroll treatment, or use card sizing and padding that makes the partial-card state feel intentional.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the second restaurant card, leaving its image and content visibly cut off at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable page content equal to the navigation bar height so cards can be fully viewed above the fixed navigation.
